About.intro: Noor is a free, Quran-first app. This page names the source and license of every piece of content.
About.quranTextBody: The Uthmani text from the Tanzil Project ({version}), copied verbatim without any change; Tanzil’s full notice is below.
About.metadataBody: Surahs, juz, hizbs, pages and sajdah positions come from the Tanzil metadata (CC BY).
About.mushafBody: Page boundaries follow the Madani Mushaf (604 pages); the line layout inside a page is approximate and may differ from the printed Mushaf.
About.fontsBody: Amiri Quran and Scheherazade New for the Quran text, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for the interface — all under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
About.notYet: No translation is approved yet. A translation is added once its source is approved.
About.tafsirBody: “{name}” — {author}, copied verbatim, without changes, from {distribution} under the {license}. Every text is shown with the tafsir’s name, author and source.
About.tafsirNoVersion: The source publishes no version number for this tafsir; the copy used is the one of {date, date, long}, identified by its SHA-256 fingerprint.
About.audioBody: Recitations are streamed ayah by ayah directly from the {name} network — not copied to our servers and not downloaded for offline use. Its terms license them for streaming and personal and educational use; copyright stays with the reciters or their estates.
About.adhkarBody: Morning and evening adhkar come from the Seen-Arabic dataset (MIT license): text, count and reference as given. Ayahs inside adhkar are shown from the Uthmani Mushaf text (Tanzil) with their reference. The “virtue” texts are not shown because they have no reference of their own. The other categories wait for an approved source.
About.prayerBody: Prayer times and the qibla direction are calculated on your device with adhan-js (MIT license); the Hijri calendar is the Umm al-Qura calendar of your browser. Your location is never sent to a server.
About.cities: The bundled city list is GeoNames cities15000 under CC BY 4.0; city names are shown as in GeoNames (Latin script).

Qibla.trueNorth: The bearing in degrees is calculated from true (geographic) north with adhan-js.
Qibla.declination: The live compass uses a magnetic sensor that measures magnetic north; the difference from true north (magnetic declination) can be several degrees in some places, and it is not corrected.
Qibla.calibrate: If the direction is unstable, move the device in a figure 8 to calibrate the sensor, away from metal and electronics.
Qibla.accuracy: Phone compasses have limited accuracy; when it matters, check the direction with another reliable means.

Privacy.intro: Noor works fully without an account. Everything you save stays in this browser on this device, and nothing is sent to a server unless you create an optional account to sync.

device.title: What is stored on your device
device.body: Your reading position, saved items, notes and collections, reading activity (pages read per day and reading time), adhkar and tasbih counts, memorization progress, your daily goal and your settings. They live in the browser’s storage (IndexedDB); you can export or delete them at any time.

account.title: The optional account
account.body: If you create an account we store your email address and a hash of your password (we never know the password itself), and sync between your devices: saved items, notes, reading position and activity, goals, settings, adhkar and memorization progress, and tasbih history. Notes are private and never shown to anyone. We do not ask for your name or anything else.

location.title: Location
location.body: Your location or city is used to compute prayer times and the Qibla on your device only. Location permission is asked only when you tap “Use my location”. It is sent to our server only if you turn on “Sync the prayer-times location” in Settings.

thirdParties.title: Outside services
thirdParties.body: Audio recitations stream directly from the Islamic Network CDN (cdn.islamic.network), which receives your IP address and the requested file. Password-reset emails are sent through Resend to your address. The site is hosted on Vercel and the account database on Neon.

none.title: What we do not do
none.body: No ads, no third-party trackers or analytics, no selling or sharing of data. Fonts and content are served from our own site.

control.title: Your control
control.body: In Settings you can export this device’s data or your account’s data as JSON, permanently delete your account and all its data from the server, remove the data from the device when signing out, and remove the downloaded Quran copy. You can also clear the site’s data in your browser settings.
